name: Politecnico di Torino
summary: Turin's technical university; six engineering and architecture bachelor's taught fully in English, entered by the TIL test or (engineering) the SAT.

ib.text: Full IB Diploma: 24+ points, 12 of them at HL, and TOK, EE and CAS passed. An IB studied wholly in English proves your English (B2 needed). Every degree needs the TIL test or SAT.

programmes.name: Architecture (English-taught)
programmes.about: Architectural design for better places to live: designing simple civic buildings, surveying modern and historic buildings, and working on projects from concept to construction.
programmes.overview: The degree centres on architectural design and planning at several scales: you learn to design simple civic buildings, survey modern and historic buildings and work through a project from first concept to management. Typical courses in a degree of this kind include design studios, history of architecture, drawing and representation, structures and building technology, and mathematics. Learning happens in design studios, labs and projects, workshops, an internship and a thesis. Graduates work as junior architects in design studios, public administration, engineering and architecture firms and construction companies, and can continue to a master's.
programmes.ib: National TIL-A test in person in Turin, sat in English; SAT not accepted. 2026: register 12 June–15 July, test 21 or 22 July.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on the TIL-A test. Up to 40 of the EU places are for the English-taught programme. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

lastYear.text: register 12 June–15 July; TIL-A 21 or 22 July

programmes.name: Automotive Engineering (entirely in English)
programmes.about: The motor vehicle as a system: its main sub-systems and how it is produced, for designing automotive components in teams; home of a long-running Formula SAE student team.
programmes.overview: The course treats the motor vehicle as an integrated system and trains junior designers to contribute to developing and producing it. After the usual engineering foundation in mathematics, physics and computing, typical courses in this field cover vehicle sub-systems, mechanical design, materials, powertrain and production processes. Learning is practical and team-based, with design projects and the university's Formula SAE student team, which has raced at European circuits such as Hockenheim and Barcelona since 2005. Graduates are prepared for roles in automotive design, engineering and production management, and many go on to a master's in a related field.
programmes.ib: TIL-I test (in English or Italian) or SAT with 650+ in each section. Places are shared with the Italian track (214 in all, 174 for EU students).
programmes.selectionNote: TIL-I score of 60/100 guarantees your first choice; from 30/100 or a valid SAT you enter the merit ranking. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Civil and Environmental Engineering
programmes.about: Design, management and upkeep of bridges, dams, roads, railways and water networks, plus the circular economy and plants that treat industrial waste.
programmes.overview: A newly designed degree that trains engineers to design, manage and maintain civil structures and infrastructure such as bridges, dams, roads, railways and water systems, while adding environmental topics: circular-economy principles for natural resources and energy, and the design and upkeep of plants that treat gaseous, liquid and solid industrial waste. Typical first-year courses in civil engineering include calculus, physics, chemistry and computing, followed by mechanics of structures, hydraulics, geotechnics and construction. Graduates work in engineering firms, public bodies and construction on infrastructure and environmental projects, or continue to a master's.
programmes.ib: TIL-I test (in English or Italian) or SAT with 650+ in each section.

programmes.name: Computer Engineering (entirely in English)
programmes.about: Designing and managing complex digital systems and judging alternative IT solutions, working with other engineers and disciplines to keep technology user-centred.
programmes.overview: The degree prepares you to manage complex digital systems and to weigh alternative IT solutions, working alongside other engineers and disciplines. Courses are taught by professors who are active in research with Italian and international academic and industrial partners, so theory is tied to examples from practice. Typical first-year subjects in computer engineering include calculus, physics, programming, computer architecture and electronics, followed by algorithms, databases, operating systems, networks and software engineering. Graduates usually go into software, systems and IT roles in companies and public bodies, or continue to a master's in computer engineering or related fields.

programmes.name: Electronic and Communications Engineering
programmes.about: Communications, electronics and computer science together: maths and physics first, then electronic systems, algorithms, digital transmission and computer networks.
programmes.overview: The degree is multidisciplinary, joining communications, electronics and computer science. Year one covers mathematics, physics, computer science, computer networks and electronics; year two continues with advanced mathematics and physics and the basics of electronic systems; year three turns to ICT topics: algorithms and programming, digital transmission and computer networks, and advanced electronic systems. Teaching is in English, chosen as the working language of ICT. Graduates are prepared for careers in information and communications technology, and typically continue to a master's in electronic, communications or computer engineering.

programmes.name: Mechanical Engineering (entirely in English)
programmes.about: A broad technical and scientific base in industrial engineering with mechanical specialisation, for design, production, management, automation and aerospace.
programmes.overview: The degree gives a broad technical and scientific base in industrial engineering and then adds mechanical specialisation, with applications in design, production, management, automation and aerospace. Learning combines lectures with laboratory work and hands-on projects, student teams that work on real engineering projects, an industrial internship and a thesis. Mobility options include a special exchange with China (PoliTong), a partnership programme with the USA and a wide European and worldwide partner network. Graduates are prepared to manage industrial transformation and innovation, working in industry or continuing to a master's and PhD research.
programmes.ib: TIL-I test (in English or Italian) or SAT with 650+ in each section. Places are shared with the Italian track (710 in all, 600 for EU students).
programmes.selectionNote: TIL-I score of 60/100 guarantees your first choice; from 30/100 or a valid SAT you enter the merit ranking. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

notes: The TIL test is sat in person in Turin, in several sessions from February; later sessions run only while places remain, and the last one is for EU and equivalent applicants only.
The 2027-28 calls are not published yet; the 2026-27 calls came out in December 2025, test registration opening in January.
Automotive, Computer and Mechanical Engineering also run in Italian; you choose the English track when you register.
